primary_prior_art.authors: Thomas L. Dean; Robert Givan; Sonia Leach

finding: LBQ001 now fixes the canonical target-side estimand to the unique exact full-consequence controlled predictive quotient relative to the preregistered action and non-semantic consequence interface. Metric thresholds, epsilon-homogeneous partitions, robust-exact relations, perturbation-repair quotients, and task-relative abstractions remain separate diagnostics and may not be reported as recovery of canonical P_LBQ.
counterexamples: Metric thresholding requires a linkage rule and can violate transitivity or merge endpoints beyond threshold.
Epsilon-homogeneous criteria can admit incomparable valid partitions, so reproducible algorithm output is not observationally unique ontology identification.
Perturbation-repair equivalence answers a nearby-model question rather than equality in the true point model.
Finite-sample failure to reject cannot certify exact equality; merge requires symbolic equality or a complete exact-model oracle.
The exact quotient remains relative to the declared consequence family and is invalidated by omitted physical channels or semantic-codebook leakage.
